name: Angelica Frockhart
original_name: アンジェリカ＝フロックハート
source:
Her father is a door-to-door salesman who sells to high class households, dealing with jewels and things.
She helps him with his work and aims to be a wealthy merchant herself in the future.
A strong girl who is always striving towards her dream, though she isn't always perfect.
